evidence.observation: H701 reads 442.9 °C while the other reboiler heater reads 70.1 °C and the vessel reads 71.0 °C; this large discrepancy persists throughout the observations.
H701 reaches 453.5 °C while H702 is 69.9 °C and the vessel is 72.1 °C.
H701 drops to 429.0 °C in one minute while H702 is 69.3 °C and the vessel is 72.2 °C; actual heater overheating cannot be distinguished from a temperature measurement fault.
Both distillate and reflux flow read zero, as they did at 960 s; no composition measurements have been supplied.

args.missing_evidence: Independent H701 temperature verification, heater power and setpoint records, and operating limits are needed to distinguish actual overheating from a sensor/readout fault. Pressure instruments are not installed, so pressure behavior is unobserved. Composition measurements and the separation target are needed to evaluate separation.
